completion_note: v12 diff clamp solved clipping (0% all features), span preserved (8/8), rho 7/8 (F3=0.96). Cohen's d 12/18 pass. Superseded by OBJ-2026-11-12-002.
title: Fix v11 high-rail clipping while preserving span and rho gains
context: v11 hybrid mirror+diode loads solved span (8/8 pass 225mV) but introduced VDD-rail clipping: F7=43.6%, F2=5.8%, F3=5.5%, F1=3.0%, F4=1.5%. Gain ~5x is too high for the signal ranges. F3 rho also degraded on records 113 (0.925) and 231 (0.904), likely due to clipping-induced nonlinear distortion. Must reduce gain to eliminate clipping without losing span.

success_criteria.target: < 1% of beats within 10mV of either rail (0V or 0.9V)

success_criteria.current_value: ALL PASS (271-631mV). Must NOT degrade below 225mV.
7/8 pass. F3=0.9597 fails. Must improve F3, must NOT degrade others.

success_criteria.target: >= 75% of Python d for all class pairs where Python d >= 0.3
success_criteria.current_value: 7/11 pass. F5 S-V, F6 N-S, F7 N-S, F7 S-V fail.

constraints: All circuits must remain fully analog SKY130 130nm CMOS — no digital blocks, no lookup tables
Do NOT modify F5 (pwave_diff.spice) — it passes all criteria
Do NOT modify F6 (qrs_width.spice) or F8 (qrs_symmetry.spice) — raw S&H circuits, pass all applicable criteria
The hybrid mirror+diode topology must be preserved (not reverted to pure diode) — it is the only topology proven to give gain > 1 without bistability
IC formula (V_sf = 0.480 - 0.176*RR) must remain valid — do NOT change the timer cap or source follower
risk_factors: Reducing mirror W may drop span below 225mV if gain is reduced too much
F3 rho issue may be structural (very small signal on L0 for records 113/231) not just clipping
Different features need different gain levels — one-size-fits-all mirror W may not work
ngspice simulation time ~2.5 hrs per record with hybrid loads — full re-validation is expensive
